provenance.reading_scope: Full local MARIO ICIO parse (Z, Y, V, E, EY), calc_all=False; raw VA/TLS totals independently reconciled by country.
provenance.split_region_handling: CN1/CN2 are summed into CHN; MX1/MX2 into MEX. National placeholder columns do not add extra VA.

geography.method: Exact ISO identifiers and country names, plus explicit source aliases. Aggregate memberships are not inferred.
